headword: {生鮮食品|せいせんしょくひん}

definitions.explanation: Foods that are fresh and have not been processed, preserved, or frozen. Includes fresh vegetables, fruits, meat, and fish.

examples.japanese: {生鮮食品|せいせんしょくひん}は{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}で{保管|ほかん}してください。
examples.english: Please store fresh food in the refrigerator.

examples.japanese: このスーパーは{生鮮食品|せいせんしょくひん}が{新鮮|しんせん}で{安|やす}い。
examples.english: This supermarket has fresh produce that's fresh and inexpensive.

examples.japanese: {生鮮食品|せいせんしょくひん}{売|う}り{場|ば}で{野菜|やさい}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought vegetables at the fresh food section.

notes:
USAGE: {生鮮食品|せいせんしょくひん} refers to perishable foods that are sold fresh, without processing. This is a common term seen in supermarkets and food retail.

CATEGORIES OF {生鮮食品|せいせんしょくひん}:
・{野菜|やさい} (vegetables)
・{果物|くだもの} (fruits)
・{肉|にく}/{精肉|せいにく} (meat)
・{魚|さかな}/{鮮魚|せんぎょ} (fish)
・{卵|たまご} (eggs)

SUPERMARKET TERMS:
・{生鮮食品|せいせんしょくひん}{売|う}り{場|ば} (fresh food section)
・{生鮮|せいせん}コーナー (fresh produce corner)

CONTRAST:
・{加工食品|かこうしょくひん} (processed food) - food that has been processed, preserved, or packaged
・{冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん} (frozen food)

cross_references.headword: {加工食品|かこうしょくひん}
cross_references.label: processed food
